feeds.title: True Love Dates » Dating
feeds.description: True Love Dates is a community of men and women dedicated to doing relationships well! All the relationship resources you will find here have been created and written by Debra Fileta, a licensed professional counselor, author and national speaker specializing in relationship and marriage issues.

feeds.title: Catholic Stand » Dating Singles
feeds.description: CATHOLIC STAND is an e-publication presenting essays and creative non-fiction, offering substantive resources with thoughtful insights into how to live the Truth that the Church teaches, owned by Little Vatican Media.

feeds.title: Traditional Catholic Femininity » Courtship Dating Blog
feeds.description: The main goals and vision for Traditional Catholic Femininity are to provide support, to inspire and be inspired by Traditional Catholic women of all ages in their vocations, as well as to promote Marian virtues, Biblical femininity, Godly womanhood, and traditional, old-fashioned values.

feeds.title: Catholic Singles » Dating Advice Blog
feeds.description: The world is full of dating advice much of which is toxic and damaging to relationships. We approach dating advice from the perspective of Catholic teachings as they relate to the persons and the role that dating and romantic relationships play in our lives as Christians. In this section, we'll explore dating advice for first-time dates as well as advice for those who are going on their 20th date.

feeds.title: Chastity Project » Dating
feeds.description: Chastity Project is a ministry of Jason and Crystalina Evert that promotes the virtue of chastity through seminars, resources, clubs, and social media. After working for Catholic Answers in San Diego for more than a decade, the couple moved to Denver and began a new ministry focused solely on promoting purity: Chastity Project.
